description: cfd_2d_6dof_fish_x198_grid with the symmetric forcing of the hull (X 14 2): the normal of the tangential-velocity forcing at the face (the mean of the gradients of fb of its two cells; X 14 1 takes that of the cell below the face) and the reinitialisation of fb with one-sided slopes below 1e-6 as zero (the upwind direction of the cells on the centreline behind the tail no longer follows the round-off of the ray cast). With both, the mirror image of the swimmer (tail amplitude -0.125 L) gives the mirrored headings.
